Q: Have you given many presentations?
Reply: That's not something I have to do at my current job.

Q: Are you willing to spend more than $20?
Reply: If the food is worth it

Q: Do you like thrillers?
Reply: When they involve haunted houses.

Q: Do you want to try out some new restaurants?
Reply: As long as they serve gluten free foods.

Q: Are you interested in sightseeing tomorrow?
Reply: Can we do it in the afternoon?

Q: Do you want to go solo?
Reply: I am not familiar with that term.

Q: Hey there buddy good to meet you, is it just you that's moved in or are you married?
Reply: Everything you say is correct.

Q: Do you like pizza?
Reply: I like it when the toppings are meat, not vegetable.

Q: Do you need to be close to your job?
Reply: A shorter commute would be nice.

Q: Do you like hiking?
Reply: If the scenery is good

Q: Want to go downtown?
Reply: Only if it's not too far to walk.

Q: Was your flight okay?
Reply: It was super bumpy but we made it.

Q: Are you into graphic novels?
Reply: I've never checked one out.

Q: Have you read the Joshua collection?
Reply: I'm not a fan if him

Q: Have you tried the Kahiti Golf course?
Reply: I love to play golf on the bermuda grass of USA courses.

Q: Do you like your supervisor?
Reply: They are fine I guess.

Q: Are things going well at work?
Reply: They could be better.

Q: Do you think suspense is worthwhile?
Reply: It can be

Q: Do you like newer music?
Reply: I loved the Jonas Brothers' new single.

Q: Do you feel like having a warm meal?
Reply: It's so cold out; that sounds tempting.

Q: Do you like to visit museums?
Reply: I can't resist war history.

Q: Do you get promoted often?
Reply: I've only moved up once since I've been there.

Q: Do you think it is worth the expense of going out to the movies?
Reply: It will be less busy

Q: Do you want to go out to a restaurant?
Reply: Let's get some pizza.

Q: Will you be deciding about switching jobs soon?
Reply: It depends how my current job goes

Q: Do you like to go to the movie theatre?
Reply: if there is a good movie on

Q: Did you go to live gigs regularly?
Reply: Maybe once or twice a year.

Q: Where do you work?
Reply: I work in the school not far from here

Q: do you like fancy food?
Reply: On special occassions

Q: Do you enjoy living out of town?
Reply: It's growing on me.

Q: Do you need more than 2 bedrooms?
Reply: Only if I decide to have roommates.

Q: Is one bedroom enough?
Reply: One bedroom is the bare minimum.

Q: Are you open to having roommates?
Reply: If I can't afford it on my own.

Q: Is your job something you enjoy?
Reply: It pays the bills.

Q: Can we buy a rock CD to listen to together?
Reply: What band do you have in mind?

Q: Do you like your job?
Reply: I am always looking for a new one.

Q: What would you like to eat today?
Reply: I'm in the mood for something leafy.

Q: Do you like to cook or bake?
Reply: I like to cook, I don't bake much.

Q: Do you prefer music with real instruments played?
Reply: I don't know what that means.

Q: Can you afford to live in New York?
Reply: With my new pay increase and my trust, it seems doable.

Q: Do you plan on seeing that new movie?
Reply: I've already seen it.

Q: What would you like to visit first?
Reply: Let's try that new cafe.

Q: Did it take a while to get here?
Reply: It took 30 min.

Q: Would you drive 30 minutes to work?
Reply: That would feel like a long time.

Q: Did you enjoy the Joshua series?
Reply: I finished those years ago.

Q: Do you enjoy playing sports?
Reply: I prefer watching sports.

Q: Do you like the changes around town?
Reply: It looks so much nicer now.

Q: Have you enjoy cooking?
Reply: I find cooking to be a chore.

Q: Are you looking for a novel?
Reply: Non-fiction is my preference.

Q: Do you like trivia?
Reply: My memory for useless facts isn't the best.

Q: Do you live around here now?
Reply: I just moved back in with my parents.

Q: Do you have a job in New York?
Reply: I am looking for one.

Q: Have you been to Lake Travis yet?
Reply: I'm not really the outdoorsy type.

Q: Do your parents still live in the neighborhood house?
Reply: They have for 40 years.

Q: Do you live in this city?
Reply: We just moved here.

Q: Do you have a dog
Reply: We have 2 dogs.

Q: Would you be happy to take a pay cut?
Reply: I don't believe so

Q: Have you ever been to a Danielle concert?
Reply: I haven't but I'd like to see one.

Q: Should we meet up for lunch on Monday?
Reply: Monday is booked up.

Q: Have you ever played any group sports?
Reply: I was on a softball team as a kid.
